ownership.summary: Pentair plc is a public company. Its 2025 annual report describes the Pool segment as designing, manufacturing and selling residential and commercial pool equipment and identifies Pentair Pool, Kreepy Krauly, Pleatco and Sta-Rite as primary Pool brands. The precise responsible entity remains product and country specific.

leadership.name: John L. Stauch
leadership.context: Pentair's public reporting identifies John L. Stauch as President and CEO; buyers should use current investor reporting for transaction-time confirmation.

productPortfolio.name: Pumps, filters, heaters and water treatment
productPortfolio.positioning: Core pool-pad equipment for residential and commercial installations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm hydraulics, voltage, local approval and installer support before combining equipment.

productPortfolio.name: Automation and lighting
productPortfolio.positioning: Connected controls, pool monitoring and lighting within the Pentair pool platform.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check controller compatibility, app support and commissioning ownership.

productPortfolio.name: Robotic, suction-side and pressure-side cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Automatic cleaners for different pool designs and system dependencies.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match pool type, booster or pump requirements, hose/cord configuration and service route.

productPortfolio.name: Kreepy Krauly, Pleatco and Sta-Rite product families
productPortfolio.positioning: Associated pool brands and components within the wider Pentair portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify the exact brand, replacement-part family and regional catalogue when ordering.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Pentair's 2025 annual report says the Pool segment designs, manufactures and sells a complete line of residential and commercial pool equipment.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the actual manufacturer, origin and certification for the specific product line.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The annual report identifies Pool segment brands but does not assign a common factory to every brand or cleaner model.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize factory, country of origin or warranty from the Pentair name alone.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Product and catalogue pages list exact pool-cleaner configurations and accessory families.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the part number, pool type and destination-market document before purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: Pentair's annual report identifies wholesale and retail distribution businesses as Pool customers in residential and commercial verticals.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm account authorization, commercial terms and reseller status for the target channel.

marketsChannels.evidence: Pentair directs pool buyers to pool professionals, dealer locations, warranty and registration resources.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the local dealer network to validate installation, support and warranty eligibility.

marketsChannels.evidence: Pool demand and product offerings differ by climate, installation standards and market.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Check local electrical, hydraulic, warranty and service requirements.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Pentair is a system-level pool equipment competitor, not just a cleaner brand. Its strength is the ability to connect cleaners, circulation, controls and service channels. For buyers, the important risk is system dependency: a cleaner, hose, booster, controller and warranty path need to be specified as one workable installation.
